'''Grove Archer''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|An armed outlaw equipped with basic ranged weaponry. Trained in the bamboo groves, the outlaw can fire an arrow through the forest without hitting a single leaf blade.}}

==Overview==
One of the basic ranged [[Cangzei Pirate]]s, Grove Archers are similar to [[Bonekrusher Ambusher]]s in terms of being a fodder enemy; They attack by either using three consecutive shots, dealing Physical damage, or throwing three bombs, dealing Physical damage in an area.
